newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RGC in Ukraine j/v with Goldfields.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RGC in Ukraine j/v with Goldfields.

text.p: RGC Ltd said on Wednesday it had formed a joint venture with Goldfields Ltd to explore and develop gold deposits in the Zakarpatska Oblast (Transcarpathian) state of the Ukraine.

RGC said the Ukrainian Ministry of Industry, the State Committee on Geology and Mineral Resources, the State Property Fund and the Administration of the Zakarpatska Oblast were also parties to the joint venture.

"The memorandum contemplates the formation of a joint venture between Ukrainian parties and RGC/Goldfields, which will concentrate initially on development of gold/polymetallic deposits of the Muzhievo Combinat, which is being established," RGC said.

"It will also involve simultaneous exploration of other gold and gold/polymetallic deposits in the Transcarpathian Oblast," it said. "In addition to gold, the areas allocated to the joint venture are considered prospective for silver, lead and zinc."
RGC Ltd owns 57 percent of Goldfields.
